headline: Backup Report for Smith County Homes
summary: Smith County has a high outlook. It sees a long outage of 12 hours or more about once every 4 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In one big storm 56% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 57 hours. Homes with gas heat need 2 Cores. One Core lasts about 17 hours in August. Two Cores last about 34 hours in August. One Core lasts about 43 hours in February. Two Cores cover 91% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
